message.content: I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password. If you’ve forgotten your password, the best approach is to use the “Forgot Password” or “Reset Password” feature on the website. That will send a secure link to your registered email address so you can create a new password safely. Let me know if you’d like instructions on how to do that!
message.reasoning: The user wants to log in with username 'john_doe' but forgot password. We cannot provide password. We can offer to reset password or help with password recovery. According to policy, we should not provide or guess passwords. So we should respond that we can't log in without password, suggest resetting password.
